subject: English
passage: The Great Mosque of Córdoba, from eighth-century Spain, features over 850 columns spanning 24,000 square feet. It was likely constructed by builders working in phases and then connecting the resulting sections together. It's plausible that the construction team had never undertaken a project of such magnitude, and some historians argue that a careful study of the transitions—the places where different building phases meet—indicates that the builders improved and standardized their construction methods throughout the project. For example, the earliest transition shows noticeable differences in column spacing and decorative patterns, while the later transitions demonstrate remarkable consistency and precision.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It supports an argument about the builders who constructed the Great Mosque of Córdoba.
choices.B: It describes the religious practices and ceremonies depicted in the Great Mosque of Córdoba.
choices.C: It contrasts the Great Mosque of Córdoba with other mosques from eighth-century Spain.
choices.D: It explains how historians determined when the Great Mosque of Córdoba was built.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most accurately describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole. The text discusses the Great Mosque of Córdoba, making the point that the builders who constructed the massive mosque in the eighth century might not have ever undertaken a project so large before. The text goes on to suggest that because of this lack of previous experience, the builders improved and standardized their construction methods over time as they worked. The last sentence of the text then provides an example of an observation that suggests the builders' methods evolved: noticeable differences in the earliest transition and remarkable consistency in later transitions. Thus, the underlined sentence serves to support an argument about the builders who constructed the mosque.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the last sentence compares how early transitions in the Great Mosque were constructed with how later transitions in the same mosque were constructed; it doesn't make any comparison between the Great Mosque and other mosques from the same time in Spain.
